title: Nyan Cat for PetsMod
body:
This mod adds Nyan Cat into [PetsMod](https://modrinth.com/mod/pets-mod).
![Nyan Cat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/750c58b72fcaa9e5b89b7299eee847809270b379_0.webp)
This is an addon for [PetsMod](https://modrinth.com/mod/pets-mod); thus, it requires it. It is fully compatible with other addons.

To use Nyan Cat as your pet, use `/petspecies nyan cat`. It supports the same behaviour and funcionalities of any other pet, including riding on your head, custom names, and animations.
